title: Air-conditioned
subtitle: 「有冷氣的／空調的」，有哪些真正接近、幾乎可以互換的說法？
description: 「有冷氣的／空調的」，有哪些真正接近、幾乎可以互換的說法？

words.meaning: 有氣候控制的；恆溫控制的
words.note: 表示室內溫度，有時也包括濕度，受到系統控制。
words.example: The museum stores the paintings in a climate-controlled room.
words.exampleZh: 博物館把畫作存放在有恆溫控制的房間內。

exercises.original: The exhibition is held in an air-conditioned gallery.
exercises.zh: 展覽在有恆溫控制的展廳舉行。
exercises.upgrade: The exhibition is held in a climate-controlled gallery.

options.explanation: 和 air-conditioned 很接近，且博物館語境中非常自然。

exercises.original: The archive keeps old documents in air-conditioned storage rooms.
exercises.zh: 檔案館把舊文件存放在恆溫控制的儲存室。
exercises.upgrade: The archive keeps old documents in climate-controlled storage rooms.

options.explanation: 文件保存語境中比一般 air-conditioned 更精確。

exercises.original: Guests can relax in an air-conditioned lounge.
exercises.zh: 賓客可在有空調控制的休息室放鬆。
exercises.upgrade: Guests can relax in a climate-controlled lounge.

options.explanation: 若重點是舒適溫度控制，意思很接近。

words.note: 表示某個空間被冷卻到較舒適或較低的溫度。
words.example: Passengers waited in a cooled waiting area.
words.exampleZh: 乘客在有冷卻設備的候車區等候。

exercises.original: Passengers waited in an air-conditioned area before boarding.
exercises.zh: 乘客登機前在有降溫設備的區域等候。
exercises.upgrade: Passengers waited in a cooled area before boarding.

options.explanation: 語境已清楚是為乘客提供較涼爽的室內環境。

exercises.original: The café has an air-conditioned indoor seating area.
exercises.zh: 咖啡店有一個已降溫的室內座位區。
exercises.upgrade: The café has a cooled indoor seating area.

options.explanation: 在上下文清楚時很接近 air-conditioned。

exercises.original: The hotel provides an air-conditioned waiting room.
exercises.zh: 酒店提供一間有降溫設備的候客室。
exercises.upgrade: The hotel provides a cooled waiting room.

options.explanation: 表示空間被降到舒適溫度。

words.meaning: 以空氣冷卻的；有空氣冷卻的
words.note: 表示透過空氣循環或冷氣系統降溫。
words.example: The passenger cabin is air-cooled for greater comfort.
words.exampleZh: 客艙採用空氣冷卻，以提高舒適度。

exercises.original: The passenger cabin is air-conditioned for comfort.
exercises.zh: 客艙採用空氣冷卻，提升舒適度。
exercises.upgrade: The passenger cabin is air-cooled for comfort.

options.explanation: 技術語境中可表示利用空氣系統降溫。

exercises.original: The equipment compartment is air-conditioned to prevent overheating.
exercises.zh: 設備艙採用空氣冷卻，以防過熱。
exercises.upgrade: The equipment compartment is air-cooled to prevent overheating.

options.explanation: 防止過熱的技術語境很自然。

exercises.original: The vehicle has an air-conditioned passenger compartment.
exercises.zh: 這輛車的乘客艙採用空氣冷卻。
exercises.upgrade: The vehicle has an air-cooled passenger compartment.

options.explanation: 在技術描述中和 air-conditioned 接近。

words.note: 表示溫度由系統維持在設定範圍內。
words.example: The medicine must be stored in a temperature-controlled room.
words.exampleZh: 藥物必須存放在溫度受控的房間。

exercises.original: The laboratory is air-conditioned to maintain a stable environment.
exercises.zh: 實驗室有溫度控制，以維持穩定環境。
exercises.upgrade: The laboratory is temperature-controlled to maintain a stable environment.

exercises.original: The storage area is air-conditioned throughout the year.
exercises.zh: 儲存區全年維持溫度受控。
exercises.upgrade: The storage area is temperature-controlled throughout the year.

options.explanation: 全年穩定控制溫度很自然。

exercises.original: Guests stayed in an air-conditioned conference hall.
exercises.zh: 賓客留在溫度受控的會議廳內。
exercises.upgrade: Guests stayed in a temperature-controlled conference hall.

options.explanation: 若強調室內舒適溫度，意思很接近。

words.note: 把 air-conditioned 的意思完整展開來說。
words.example: The lounge is cooled by air conditioning throughout the summer.
words.exampleZh: 夏季期間，休息室全程由空調降溫。

exercises.original: The lobby is air-conditioned during the summer.
exercises.zh: 夏季期間，大堂由空調降溫。
exercises.upgrade: The lobby is cooled by air conditioning during the summer.

options.explanation: 幾乎完整展開 air-conditioned 的意思。

exercises.original: The rooms are air-conditioned all day.
exercises.zh: 房間全天由空調降溫。
exercises.upgrade: The rooms are cooled by air conditioning all day.

exercises.original: The bus is fully air-conditioned.
exercises.zh: 這輛巴士全車由空調降溫。
exercises.upgrade: The bus is fully cooled by air conditioning.

options.explanation: 和 fully air-conditioned 幾乎同義。

words.note: 強調某個空間、車輛或建築物「有安裝空調設備」。
words.example: All rooms are equipped with air conditioning.

exercises.original: All hotel rooms are air-conditioned.
exercises.zh: 所有酒店房間都配備空調。
exercises.upgrade: All hotel rooms are equipped with air conditioning.

options.explanation: 強調房間裝有空調設備。

exercises.original: The new trains are air-conditioned.
exercises.zh: 新列車都配備空調。
exercises.upgrade: The new trains are equipped with air conditioning.

exercises.original: The office is fully air-conditioned.
exercises.zh: 辦公室全面配備空調。
exercises.upgrade: The office is fully equipped with air conditioning.

options.explanation: 和 fully air-conditioned 很接近。

words.note: 最直接、自然的改寫之一。
words.example: We booked a room with air conditioning.
words.exampleZh: 我們訂了一間有空調的房間。

exercises.original: We booked an air-conditioned room.
exercises.zh: 我們訂了一間有空調的房間。
exercises.upgrade: We booked a room with air conditioning.

options.explanation: 最直接自然的改寫之一。

exercises.original: The restaurant has an air-conditioned dining area.
exercises.zh: 餐廳有一個有空調的用餐區。
exercises.upgrade: The restaurant has a dining area with air conditioning.

options.text: dining area with natural ventilation only

exercises.original: Passengers can wait in an air-conditioned lounge.
exercises.zh: 乘客可以在有空調的休息室等候。
exercises.upgrade: Passengers can wait in a lounge with air conditioning.

falseSynonyms.zh: 通風不等於有冷氣 ventilated 表示有空氣流通，但不一定有降溫。 這個房間通風很好，但沒有冷氣。
falseSynonyms.point: The room is well ventilated but not air-conditioned.

falseSynonyms.zh: 有暖氣不等於有冷氣 heated 表示有加熱設備。
隔熱不等於空調 insulated 表示有隔熱層，可以幫助保持溫度，但不代表有冷氣。
涼爽不等於有空調 房間可能因天氣、風或陰影而涼爽，不一定裝了空調。
冷藏不等於空調 refrigerated 通常指更低溫的冷藏環境，例如冷藏貨車、倉庫。
